title: Requirement pointing at a local path
description: setup.cfg declares an `install_requires` entry that resolves from disk. A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads an `install_requires` entry that resolves from disk.
remediation: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix an `install_requires` entry that resolves from disk.
limitation: It matches an `install_requires` entry that resolves from disk in the parsed setup.cfg; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
